ev.q: Forty-eight (83%) of all cases were confirmed by positive measles IgM or RT-PCR result
In 52% of cases, measles was likely acquired from a relative
12 (21%) of the cases were in infants too young
the primary reasons for lack of vaccination were refusal (nine, 30%) and delay (eight, 27%)
In 31% of cases, no medical care for rash illness had been sought
the median age of 28 infected persons was 10 years (range: 0–32 years)
the median age of 30 infected persons was 19 months (range: 0 months–32 years)
A total of 58 cases* were identified, including six generations of measles infection

methods_quotes.q: Investigation of suspected cases included patient interviews, medical record reviews, and ascertainment of immunization records.
Cases were identified in residents of New York City and classified according to the Council of State and Territorial Epidemiologists clinical case definition
